status_definitions.qemu_tested: A focused executable or OS path ran in QEMU and emitted its expected result.
status_definitions.build_tested: Compilation/linking succeeded, but target execution has not been proven.
status_definitions.implemented_partial: Source support exists, but semantics or coverage are incomplete.
status_definitions.not_implemented: No native OCTAGRAM implementation/executable has been demonstrated.

components.summary: Custom Rust target identity x86_64-unknown-octagram builds a freestanding ELF with target_os=octagram.
evidence: tools/check_octagram_rust_target.py validates rustc cfg
make -C user/rust build-octagram links rust_hello_octagram.elf
QEMU run 44713729286 emitted M4-RUST-TARGET-EXEC-PASS
limitations: LLVM backend triple remains x86_64-unknown-none
This is an application target; it does not make rustc an OCTAGRAM host executable
next_gate: Integrate an OCTAGRAM host target into the rustc source build and supported-target tables

components.summary: Nightly build-std compiles core for the custom OCTAGRAM target.
evidence: CI step Compile no_std runtime for experimental OCTAGRAM host target
limitations: Build runs on Linux; no OCTAGRAM rustc/std sysroot exists
next_gate: Build and test a host sysroot for x86_64-unknown-octagram

components.summary: alloc is compiled for the experimental target; guest Vec allocation of 2 MiB runs.
evidence: octagram-alloc-probe compiles with build-std=core,alloc
/bin/rust-hello-octagram emits RUST-NOSTD-PASS in QEMU run 44713729286
limitations: No global allocator or std host runtime suitable for rustc is proven
next_gate: Build allocator and collection-heavy host utilities on top of a real target sysroot

components.summary: octagram-runtime exports memset, memcpy, memmove, and memcmp for freestanding links.
evidence: Six octagram-runtime unit tests pass in CI run 44713729286
limitations: These functions are not a libc implementation
next_gate: Expand runtime ABI tests under sanitizers/target guest tests where supported

components.summary: Rust guest allocates and writes a 2 MiB Vec through the OCTAGRAM runtime allocator.
evidence: Rust custom target guest emits its target marker and exits with status 0 in QEMU run 44713729286
limitations: Large-process memory pressure, allocator fragmentation, multithreaded allocation contention, and OOM recovery are not fully characterized
next_gate: Add allocator stress, multithreaded allocation, and OOM behavior tests

components.summary: Rust guest calls stat, open, read, and close against a seeded VFS file.
evidence: Rust runtime file/stat: PASS in QEMU run 44713729286
limitations: Directory traversal, rename durability, large source trees, mtime precision, and crash consistency are not validated as a Rust std contract
next_gate: Add Rust filesystem conformance tests for cwd, directories, rename, timestamps, and error mapping

components.summary: ELF loader, fork, execve, waitpid, pipe, and descriptor inheritance are implemented and some compatibility paths are QEMU-tested.
evidence: syscall ABI documentation and user syscall-compat-demo
QEMU syscall compatibility smoke test in run 44713729286
limitations: Process limit is 16; descriptor limit is 16; not all Linux process and spawn semantics are implemented
next_gate: Add dedicated fork/exec/wait/pipe inheritance tests and document exact errno/edge behavior

components.summary: Kernel thread creation/join, static TLS, FS base switching, timer preemption, and SSE state preservation pass the guest smoke test.
evidence: M4-ABI-TLS-PASS and M4-ABI-THREADS-PASS in QEMU run 44713729286 without scheduler trace logging
limitations: Dynamic TLS for shared objects is not implemented; pthread semantics are a partial POSIX subset
next_gate: Implement and test dynamic TLS only if the chosen rustc/LLVM host build actually requires it

components.summary: Kernel implements WAIT, WAKE, WAIT_BITSET, WAKE_BITSET, and REQUEUE; the compatibility demo is being extended with guest tests for bitsets and requeue.
evidence: kernel/src/elf.rs syscall_futex and helper functions
existing futex WAIT/WAKE and timeout tests in syscall-compat-demo
limitations: Waiter matching is restricted to the same PID; private flag is accepted but ignored; CMP_REQUEUE, WAKE_OP, and PI operations return ENOSYS
next_gate: Require QEMU pass for WAIT_BITSET deadline, bitset filtering, and REQUEUE-to-target tests in the current branch run

components.summary: Anonymous mmap and protection/TLS related guest paths run in QEMU.
evidence: M4-ABI-MMAP-PASS in QEMU run 44713729286
limitations: MAP_PRIVATE is eagerly copied rather than COW; no SIGBUS at mapped EOF; mlock does not pin against swapping because swapping does not exist
next_gate: Add mmap stress and file-backed mapping conformance for the host runtime

components.summary: Clock, sleep, and getrandom syscalls exist and basic compatibility checks run.
evidence: docs/syscall-abi.md syscall table and syscall-compat-demo
limitations: Realtime clock derives from RTC at one-second resolution; monotonic is about 1 ms; getrandom is xorshift seeded from TSC and flags do not change behavior
next_gate: Provide a stronger entropy source and define precise clock/sleep semantics for std and compiler dependencies

components.summary: Basic signal delivery, masking, handlers, and sigreturn are implemented.
evidence: kernel/src/elf.rs signal dispatch and syscall-compat-demo signal paths
limitations: Some flags such as SA_SIGINFO and SA_NOCLDSTOP are accepted without full behavior; delivery and restart semantics are a subset
next_gate: Run a focused signal conformance suite before relying on std process behavior

components.summary: Static ELF is supported and a limited PT_INTERP/PIE loader exists for current userland.
evidence: kernel ELF loader; dynamic userland build and smoke artifacts
limitations: Not a complete Linux dynamic loader; relocation, TLS, symbol versions, dlopen, and complex shared-library combinations are incomplete
next_gate: Select static-link strategy or specify the exact dynamic loader features required by a rustc/LLVM build

components.summary: IPv4 TCP/UDP subsets and DNS helpers exist.
evidence: docs/syscall-abi.md networking sections and userland network demos
limitations: sendmsg/recvmsg are ENOSYS; no full IPv6 or general socket-option parity; blocking and nonblocking behavior is partial
next_gate: Vendor dependencies and determine whether Stage 0 rustc/Cargo/LLVM need network support at all

components.summary: OCTAGRAM has a freestanding libc/runtime with errno, TLS errno, POSIX wrappers, and a tested subset.
evidence: user/runtime.c and user/include
libc host tests and QEMU syscall compatibility demo
limitations: Not glibc or musl ABI-compatible; only the documented OCTAGRAM ABI is supported
next_gate: Define a Rust std port boundary against OCTAGRAM libc instead of assuming Linux libc compatibility

components.summary: No Rust std build or std conformance test for OCTAGRAM exists.
evidence: No target std build is present in the CI workflow or workspace
limitations: Many OS contracts and runtime dependencies are incomplete
next_gate: Audit std modules actually required by rustc host before porting the entire standard library

components.summary: No rustc executable has been built to run on OCTAGRAM.
evidence: Current CI invokes host Cargo/rustc nightly to cross-build the guest ELF
limitations: Host sysroot, std, platform integration, compiler backend, and linker dependencies are missing
next_gate: Build-stage0 compiler for Linux that cross-builds a runnable OCTAGRAM host rustc

components.summary: Cargo has not run as a native OCTAGRAM process.
evidence: Current Cargo commands execute in GitHub Actions on Linux
limitations: Needs host rustc, filesystem/process APIs, locks, environment, subprocesses, and offline registry support
next_gate: Port Cargo only after rustc and its sysroot execute natively

components.summary: LLD is installed on CI Linux and links the guest; no OCTAGRAM-native LLVM/LLD executable or backend library is proven.
evidence: CI Install host dependencies installs lld; custom target Cargo linker uses ld.lld from host
limitations: No native linker executable/backend on OCTAGRAM; TinyCC linker subset is not an LLD replacement
next_gate: Choose backend delivery (static or shared library) and prove native host linker execution before rustc Stage 0

components.summary: No Stage 0 rustc for OCTAGRAM or Stage 0 to Stage 1 rebuild has been attempted.
evidence: Roadmap M4.4 remains unchecked
limitations: Build/host/target pipeline and target integration in rustc source are still design work
next_gate: Pin rust compiler source revision, bootstrap host toolchain, sysroot, build/host/target triples, and target table patch
